semiconductor_relevance: High — Akoneer specializes in laser equipment for semiconductor packaging, utilizing innovative SSAIL technology for high-precision machining.
summary: Akoneer is a laser machine integrator that provides ultrashort pulse laser equipment specifically designed for the semiconductor packaging industry. Their patented SSAIL technology enables the formation of narrow copper traces on various dielectric materials, enhancing the manufacturing process of high-density electronic circuits.
capabilities: Process recipes for laser and chemical processes
